description:
You are an EHS manager standardizing an old chemical inventory. On the Desktop, you will find a file named 'legacy_inventory_list.txt' containing 6 common/legacy chemical names (e.g., 'Muriatic Acid', 'MEK'). 

Your goal is to:
1. Search for each name on the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/).
2. Identify the official Standard Name, CAS Number, and UN/NA Number for each.
3. Create a new CSV file at '~/Documents/standardized_inventory.csv' with exactly these columns: 'Input Name', 'Standard Name', 'CAS Number', 'UN Number'.

Ensure the CAS and UN numbers are accurate. The CSV should contain a header row and 6 data rows.
